authority_or_event: Continental Congress resolution extending seven years' half-pay to widows of qualifying officers, or to orphan children if no eligible widow remained
citation: Journals of the Continental Congress, vol. 17, pp. 772-773
relevance_to_project: First national widow-pension authority in scope; limited to officers and dependent on state implementation
notes: Not a general pension for all Revolutionary veterans' widows

authority_or_event: Federal continuation of invalid pensions previously paid by states
relevance_to_project: Administrative transition to the new federal government; concerns invalid pensions rather than a new general widow benefit
notes: Do not classify a widow payment under this act without record evidence

authority_or_event: Federal procedure for new Revolutionary invalid-pension applications
relevance_to_project: Veteran invalid-pension context and claims administration, not a general widow-pension law
notes: Congress retained substantial claim-level control

authority_or_event: Time limit for claims under the August 24, 1780 resolution expired
citation: Date within 1794 not established in reviewed source
relevance_to_project: Ends the ordinary claim window described by NARA; private acts and residual claims continued
notes: Exact day is unknown and must not be invented or used for automatic day-level assignment

authority_or_event: Private pension acts for named individuals
citation: Multiple private acts in Statutes at Large
relevance_to_project: A private act could authorize an award in any later chronological period and must override date-based assumptions about authority
notes: Open-ended overlay category, not one chronological regime

authority_or_event: Service pensions for needy Revolutionary veterans with qualifying Continental or naval service
relevance_to_project: Created veteran service pensions; widow records may concern an unpaid balance rather than a widow pension in her own right
notes: Must distinguish veteran entitlement from widow authority

authority_or_event: Property schedules and need review for 1818 pensioners
relevance_to_project: Changed the 1818 veteran service-pension regime and therefore the context of later balance claims
notes: Contextual boundary, not a widow eligibility expansion

authority_or_event: Restoration mechanism for veterans removed under the 1820 need review
relevance_to_project: Changed the veteran-pension context from which unpaid balances could arise
notes: Contextual boundary, not a widow eligibility expansion

authority_or_event: Full-pay life pensions for qualifying surviving Revolutionary officers and enlisted men
relevance_to_project: Veteran service-pension authority; a widow could appear as recipient of an unpaid balance or under a separate private act
notes: Not a general widow pension

authority_or_event: Expanded Revolutionary service pensions; unpaid amount from last payment to veteran's death collectible by widow or children
relevance_to_project: Directly relevant to records that name a widow but document a deceased veteran's accrued pension rather than her own award
notes: Balance payment must not be counted as an annual widow award

authority_or_event: Federal treatment of specified Virginia half-pay claims and heirs
relevance_to_project: Relevant separate half-pay/heir claim stream referenced by NARA; not equivalent to a general widow pension
notes: Some related files are outside the M804 microfilm series

authority_or_event: General public-law widow eligibility tied to service specified by the 1832 act and marriage before the veteran's last service
relevance_to_project: Beginning of the broad federal Revolutionary widow-pension sequence used in the existing notebook
notes: Still preserve private acts and balance claims separately

authority_or_event: Five-year pensions for widows married after service but before January 1, 1794
relevance_to_project: Expanded general Revolutionary widow eligibility
notes: Pension ran from March 4, 1836 under the statute

authority_or_event: Continuation for one additional year of pensions tied to the 1838 authority
relevance_to_project: Changed duration of the 1838 widow benefit
notes: Chronological boundary remains distinct from the governing law on a later certificate

authority_or_event: Revived and extended the 1843 widow pensions for four years from March 4, 1844
relevance_to_project: Further continuation of the 1838 widow benefit
notes: Also admitted qualifying special-act widows to its benefit

authority_or_event: Life pensions during widowhood for qualifying widows married before January 1, 1794
relevance_to_project: Converted the covered Revolutionary widow benefit from a term to a life benefit during widowhood
notes: Effective pension commencement could still be March 4, 1848

authority_or_event: Life pensions for Revolutionary widows married before January 1, 1800
relevance_to_project: Expanded the permissible marriage-date class
notes: Do not substitute this law date for certificate or commencement date

authority_or_event: Extended Revolutionary Army widow eligibility to marriages after January 1, 1800; also continued half-pay for other covered widows and orphans
relevance_to_project: Removed the prior Revolutionary Army marriage-date limitation described in the earlier sequence
notes: Army and other-war provisions should be separately classified

authority_or_event: Extended the 1853 post-1800 marriage rule to widows of Revolutionary naval officers, marines, and mariners
relevance_to_project: Substantive expansion for the Revolutionary naval subgroup
notes: Not simply a repeat of the Army provision

authority_or_event: Continued covered five-year half-pay for widows during life and included qualifying special-act awards
relevance_to_project: Changed duration for a half-pay class and explicitly addressed special-act continuations
notes: Excluded persons already receiving a pension for life

authority_or_event: Cut off unestablished claims by children or descendants of Revolutionary veterans if not established by the veteran or widow
relevance_to_project: Relevant claims limitation but not a new widow award rate
notes: Keep in chronology; not proposed as a primary widow-distribution boundary

authority_or_event: Increased certain widow pensions for minor children and extended newer rules to previous-law pensions except Revolutionary pensioners
relevance_to_project: Important context; the express Revolutionary exception prevents treating it alone as a general Revolutionary widow boundary
notes: Later 1868 legislation changed the treatment of older pensioners

authority_or_event: Increased pensions of Revolutionary widows already on the rolls who married before 1800 to the rate the deceased veteran would receive
relevance_to_project: Substantive Revolutionary widow rate change, retroactive to September 30, 1865
notes: Applies to the specified on-roll and marriage class

authority_or_event: Set Revolutionary soldiers' and sailors' widows receiving less at eight dollars per month and revised older-pension treatment
relevance_to_project: Substantive common-rate boundary for Revolutionary widows
notes: A later certificate can still cite an earlier entitlement law

authority_or_event: Revised and consolidated pension laws, including old-war rate, proof, remarriage, filing, and roll rules
relevance_to_project: Administrative and legal consolidation affecting interpretation and payment of older claims
notes: Use as a chronological administration boundary, not inferred governing authority

authority_or_event: Made a Revolutionary soldier's widow eligible where the soldier served fourteen days or participated in an engagement; rate eight dollars per month
relevance_to_project: Last identified broad Revolutionary widow eligibility expansion before the represented endpoint
notes: NARA also identifies this as the late major Revolutionary widow expansion

authority_or_event: Restored certain pre-1866 naval pension rates that had been reduced
relevance_to_project: Relevant to naval widows and rate anomalies; narrower than a general Revolutionary widow expansion
notes: Retain as subgroup boundary and possible explanation for high awards

authority_or_event: Latest parsed certificate issue date in the current event data
relevance_to_project: Defines the requested research endpoint only; it is not legislation
notes: Page also refers to 1839-1842 activity and likely contains a misread 1839 date; chronology is carried through 1899 without accepting the date as true
